audience: support teams that answer customer tickets in one LiveAgent help desk

useCases.title: Find tickets waiting for a reply
useCases.text: List tickets filtered by status, department or dates. Then read the messages of one ticket.

useCases.title: Check whether a ticket breaks its SLA
useCases.text: Read the SLA state of a ticket with its due times and breaches. Read its change history for status and agent changes.

useCases.title: Look up a customer contact
useCases.text: List customer contacts with their name, email and company. Open one contact to read its custom fields.

useCases.title: See the queues and teams of the help desk
useCases.text: List the departments, the agent groups and the support agents. Open one agent to read its departments and groups.

useCases.title: Open a ticket for a customer
useCases.text: Create a ticket for a customer. It sends no email to the customer unless you ask it to. Then update its status or department.
